name: A Positive 579-Concept Separated Singleton Repair
definition: Take two disjoint-coordinate copies $(B_1,0),(B_2,0)$ of the 289-concept rooted factor, form their one-point amalgam $C=B_1\vee B_2$, add the certified repairing tip $d=290$ in the first block, and lift the two components of $C-0$ to opposite sides of a fresh coordinate while lifting $d$ with the first component.
parameters: The contraction $C$ has $577$ concepts; the lifted output has $579$ concepts and isometric dimension $25$. Its reduction in the fresh direction is the singleton $\{0\}$.
properties: The contraction is the forbidden double, the repaired contraction $(B_1\cup\{d\})\vee B_2$ is corner-peelable, and the repair touches only the first component. Although the other component is untouched in the opposite layer, the 579-concept lift is also corner-peelable. Thus the untouched-component condition for a forbidden repair lift is necessary but not sufficient.
